items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress steps in
items.summary: Days after the board opened a probe into his conduct, Huang stepped down and CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while a permanent replacement is sought. Losing its founder-CEO creates leadership uncertainty for the AI chip leader just before its quarterly report.

items.title: TSMC October sales up nearly 60% to a 2026 high
items.summary: TSMC reported October revenue of about NT$587 billion, up 59.7% from a year earlier and its best month of the year. It confirms AI chip demand is still running hot heading into the fourth quarter.

items.title: Starship upper stage caught by the tower after orbital flight
items.summary: On Flight 15, SpaceX's Starship returned from orbit and was captured by the launch tower's arms for the first time, though the planned booster catch was skipped. Full reuse of the upper stage is key to cutting launch costs and to Starlink and Moon-mission plans.

items.title: Constellation beats in Q3 and raises its 2026 profit outlook
items.summary: Constellation's third-quarter results topped estimates and it lifted full-year earnings guidance, citing strong demand for reliable nuclear power from data centers. It also laid out a plan to expand its nuclear output.

items.title: Anthropic launches office tools aimed at Microsoft and Google
items.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude-based office apps, including a spreadsheet tool, ahead of its IPO, putting it in direct competition with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. It is a new competitive threat to one of Microsoft's core profit engines.
